user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Training generative AI foundation models; improve model usefulness and safety
user_agents.scope: Crawl content used for training generative AI models; honors per-UA robots.txt disallow

user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live responses to user queries

user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests when users ask questions; fetches pages to provide accurate answers and citation links

user_agents.name: Applebot

user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; analyzes data already crawled by Applebot for AI training
